name: Hill Climb Racing Vita
author: MemoryHunter
description: Hill Climb Racing is a game made by Fingersoft, a Finnish game engine where you can control a vehicle and try to survive as far as possible to get more coins for more upgrades, vehicles and stages! Each stage has a different layout, and different obstacles to overcome. Each vehicle has their own strengths and weaknesses, making certain vehicles excel in certain stages, and their vehicles have overalls.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
